title: Fighter No. 1
desc: A talented street fighter falls for a visually impaired woman whose kindness transforms his life. Furthermore, they seek peace despite constant threats.

desc: The life of an honest doctor changes forever after an injured gangster, who is on the run, arrives at his clinic for treatment.

title: Ravanasura
desc: Ravindra, an inept junior lawyer at a law firm, agrees to help a business magnate clear her father's name of murder. However, when bodies start piling up, Ravindra begins to show his true colours.
